Q: Git: Is there a way to figure out where a commit was cherry-pick'ed from? A:

One can be deceived in one case.

If you run:

git log --oneline --no-merges --cherry-pick --left-only main...feature-branch

And then git cherry-pick <sha>.

It will work if the commit you cherry picked was an empty commit to begin with.
